name: Qiblah Demo Mosque
address: Demo Community Centre, London, UK (fictional address)
about: A fictional community mosque for testing Qiblah. This sample profile brings together daily prayers, learning, family activities and community support. All schedules, staff, facilities and contact details shown here are demonstration data.

demo_content.accessibility: Step-free entrance, accessible toilet and ground-floor prayer space
demo_content.parking: 12 sample parking spaces; two accessible bays

announcements.title: Family Open Day
announcements.description: Meet the demo team, tour the sample facilities and enjoy a community lunch. Families welcome.

announcements.title: Beginner Arabic Course
announcements.description: An eight-week sample course covering the alphabet, reading and everyday vocabulary.

announcements.title: Community Clean-Up Morning
announcements.description: A sample volunteer event for neighbours and families. Equipment and refreshments provided.

announcements.title: Friday Reminder
announcements.description: Please arrive early for Jumu'ah and keep entrances clear. Three sample congregations are listed above.

announcements.title: Monthly Community Dinner
announcements.description: Share a meal and hear about the demo mosque's community programmes.
